t: You're at Golders Green Jewish Cemetery, usually known as Hoop Lane. It is maintained by a joint burial committee of the West London Synagogue and the Sephardi community. Many well-known people are buried here. Honor Blackman is one, the actress who played Pussy Galore in Goldfinger. The cellist Jacqueline du Pré is here, and Erich Segal, who wrote Love Story. The songwriter Mort Shuman, co-writer of Viva Las Vegas, is also buried here. So are the composer Sir Frederic Cowen and the politician Leslie Hore-Belisha, who modernised Britain's roads as Minister of Transport.
